text:
Type: white six-drawer chest
Use: storing clothes and linens, top for lamps, a TV or decor; bedroom, living room
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, modern
Materials: white matte painted fiberboard, black slot grips
Colors: white, black grip accents
Shape: wide low chest with a column of three wide drawers beside a column of three narrow ones, flush handleless fronts with black cut-out grips at the top edge, flat top, low plinth, clean geometric lines, medium visual weight
Feel: clean, orderly, bright, calm
Goes with: light wood floors, white or grey walls, black accents; minimalist or Scandinavian bedrooms and living rooms

product.name: NORDLI
product.description: Of course your home should be a safe place for the entire family. Thats why a safety fitting is included so that you can attach the chest of drawers to the wall.
